page_title: INT 6-2 PIS | Inter v Pisa 23/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Matteo Marcenaro has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' 6 - 2 Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) rises high to head the corner in the net and beyond the goalkeeper.
90+3' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+2' The linesman signals that Idrissa Toure (Pisa) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) attempts to find Alessandro Bastoni with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) produces a cross from the resulting free kick from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper smothers the ball.
89' Nicolo Barella (Inter) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

86' 5 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 5:2. Simone Scuffet was helpless.
85' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
85' A pass by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
84' Simone Scuffet displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

82' 4 - 2 Sensational! Federico Dimarco (Inter) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the right post and in the net. The assist goes to Marcus Thuram and the score changes to 4:2.
81' A pass from Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) is intercepted by Simone Scuffet and the move breaks down.
80' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Lautaro Martinez will be replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Augusto departs the field of play to be replaced by Manuel Akanji (Inter).

79' Simone Scuffet doesn't have to worry about this one. Lautaro Martinez plays a pass into the feet of Marcus Thuram (Inter), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
78' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
77' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
75' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris sends over an inswinging corner and Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just over the bar.
75' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) is about to take a corner kick.
73' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer was alert and made a comfortable save.
72' Carlos Augusto (Inter) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Simone Scuffet scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
71' PENALTY APPEAL after Piotr Zielinski (Inter) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
71' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) tries to find Piotr Zielinski with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
70' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Michel Aebischer is replaced by Lorran (Pisa).
69' Total attempts – 26:6. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 8:2.
69' A substitution has been made. Samuele Angori goes off and Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) comes on.

68' A cross is whipped into the box by Piotr Zielinski (Inter) and Lautaro Martinez controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the right post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot.
67' A crossfield pass from Francesco Coppola (Pisa) fails to find any of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Inter.
67' Marcus Thuram (Inter) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
64' The rebound finds Carlos Augusto (Inter) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!

63' Marcus Thuram (Inter) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is first to get to a rebound inside the six-yard box. He beats the goalkeeper with a nice strike to the bottom left corner, but one of the defenders gets in the way and the ball glances off him onto the post and away.
61' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcus Thuram (Inter) replacing Francesco Pio Esposito.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Petar Sucic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolo Barella (Inter).

60' A rebound falls to Federico Dimarco (Inter) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Simone Scuffet anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.

59' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Simone Scuffet shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
57' Carlos Augusto plays a hopeful lofted pass into the box. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) luckily gets his head to the ball and sends it narrowly wide of the right post from near the penalty spot.

56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) will miss the next game.
54' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips in a cross from the corner, but Simone Scuffet is well positioned and punches the ball away.
54' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Simone Canestrelli (Pisa). Matteo Marcenaro saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
50' Petar Sucic (Inter) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
47' Petar Sucic (Inter) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
47' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Gabriele Piccinini and Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) is off.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Marius Marin (Pisa) is replaced by Ebenezer Akinsanmiro.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 3 - 2 Goal! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Alessandro Bastoni and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 3:2.
45+1' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45+1' Samuele Angori (Pisa) will deliver the corner kick.
45+1' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

41' 2 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Federico Dimarco finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom left corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Simone Scuffet had no chance of stopping that. 2:2.
40' Alberto Gilardino is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Henrik Meister (Pisa) suffers an injury and Rafiu Durosinmi comes on.
39' 1 - 2 Goal! Piotr Zielinski (Inter) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Simone Scuffet into the roof of the net.
39' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
39' Referee Matteo Marcenaro is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Inter!
38' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Inter, he's going to review using VAR.

37' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Inter are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
37' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
37' Federico Dimarco (Inter) volleys the ball towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his shot by pulling off a wonderful save.
36' Yann Bisseck (Inter) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
36' Corner kick. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is ready to send the ball into the box.
34' It will be a substitution. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is ready to enter the pitch as Luis Henrique walks off.
34' An attempted cross from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is cleared.
33' 10:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 0:2.
32' What a huge chance for Petar Sucic (Inter). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
30' Alberto Gilardino appears to have said too much and referee Matteo Marcenaro comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
30' Henrik Meister (Pisa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
27' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Lautaro Martinez (Inter) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
27' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
27' Marius Marin (Pisa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
23' 0 - 2 Gooal! Matteo Tramoni takes over corner duties. Stefano Moreo (Pisa) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 0:2.
23' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) steps up to send the ball in.

23' Samuele Angori (Pisa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Pisa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

22' Samuele Angori (Pisa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Pisa will take a corner.
20' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared.
20' Carlos Augusto (Inter) sends a cross in and finds Lautaro Martinez inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
19' CLOSE! Yann Bisseck (Inter) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
18' 81:19 – the ratio of ball possession.
17' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
17' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

16' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Stefan de Vrij (Inter). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
16' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Piotr Zielinski (Inter), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
15' Marius Marin (Pisa) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
15' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) works the corner short.
14' A cross from Michel Aebischer (Pisa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
13' Luis Henrique nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
11' 0 - 1 GOAL! Keeper Yann Sommer totally miss kicks the ball straight to Stefano Moreo (Pisa), who slams the ball into the net from long range. It’s now 0:1.
11' Petar Sucic (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
7' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and signals a foul after Petar Sucic (Inter) brought his opponent down.

5' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Nightmare of a shot. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box but his shot goes high and wide of the goal.
4' Carlos Augusto (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Simone Scuffet comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Luis Henrique (Inter) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
3' Inter hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Inter will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Matteo Marcenaro.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
